description:
Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid)
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Compensation: $155,000–$185,000 Base Salary + Equity
 Travel: 25–50% to Customer Sites
 
 About the Opportunity
 We are supporting our client who is an innovative technology company developing AI-powered solutions for complex industrial operations. The organization helps manufacturers, logistics providers, and other industrial businesses connect fragmented enterprise data, streamline operational decisions, and automate critical workflows.
 They are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to lead customer implementations, develop production-ready AI agents, and translate complex operational challenges into scalable technical solutions.
 This is a highly technical, customer-facing opportunity for an engineer who enjoys building software, solving ambiguous problems, and working directly with customers to deliver measurable business outcomes.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead technical deployments from initial discovery and workflow analysis through production implementation and optimization.
 Partner directly with customer stakeholders to understand business processes, identify operational challenges, and document decision-making workflows.
 Design and develop AI agents, data models, and integrations that support critical operational processes.
 Work with enterprise data from multiple systems to develop reliable, scalable solutions.
 Write, test, and document production-quality code that can be maintained and reused across implementations.
 Develop evaluation methods to measure AI agent accuracy, reliability, and performance.
 Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customer stakeholders, including operational teams, IT, and executive leadership.
 Incorporate customer feedback into ongoing development and rapidly troubleshoot implementation challenges.
 Collaborate with internal product and engineering teams to improve platform capabilities and develop reusable technical components.
 Take ownership of technical delivery and ensure implemented solutions produce measurable operational improvements.
 
 
 Requirements 
 
 3+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, technical consulting, or a related field.
 Experience developing and deploying production software using Python or TypeScript .
 Strong SQL skills and experience working with complex data structures or integrating data from existing enterprise systems.
 Hands-on experience building applications, AI agents, or data pipelines using large language models (LLMs) .
 Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
 Experience gathering requirements, analyzing workflows, and collaborating directly with customers or business users.
 Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership, and comfort working in fast-paced environments with evolving requirements.
 Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and deliver iterative solutions.
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Previous experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing software implementation.
 Familiarity with industrial or enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, TMS, or GIS platforms.
 Experience designing intuitive interfaces or workflows for operational users.
 Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, or industrial technology environments.
 
 What Success Looks Like
 Within the First 90 Days: 
 Lead technical discovery and workflow documentation for an active customer implementation.
 Deliver an initial production-ready AI solution in collaboration with customer stakeholders.
 Identify opportunities to standardize or automate recurring implementation tasks.
 Within the First Year: 
 Independently lead an end-to-end customer deployment.
 Establish strong technical relationships with customer stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
 Develop reusable solutions or components that improve future implementations.
 
 Benefits 
 Compensation & Benefits
 Base salary: $155,000–$185,000 annually
 Equity participation
 Medical insurance, with approximately 90% of premiums covered by the employer
 Dental insurance, with approximately 75% of premiums covered by the employer
 Optional vision insurance
 Hybrid work arrangement based in Chicago
 Travel to customer locations, estimated at 25–50%, particularly during discovery and implementation phases
 Equal Opportunity
 Our client is committed to equal employment opportunity and considers qualified applicants based on their experience, skills, and ability to succeed in the role. Reasonable accommodations are available during the hiring process.
